text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired to service `data-orchestration-night` (severity: urgent). Alert: high inference latency (>1200ms p95) in us-west2 for model variant redwood-v2-8b. Incident link: https://pagerduty.example/INC123456 :rotating_light:

Morgan (on-call): ACK. Seeing lots of dropped requests in the prod us-west cluster.

Priya N: @Morgan do you have the night schedule? this looks like it should have hit infra-night but I see infra-day got it.

Morgan (on-call): I just checked — my oncall is infra-night. The page text shows `service: data-orchestration-night`, but PD routed to `infra-deployments` service.

Alex W: this smells like the schedule mapping we updated yesterday. I edited `infra-service-mapping` to point `data-orchestration-*` -> `infra-deployments` for daytime buckets and forgot to add the night alias.

Tariq - SRE: temporarily reassigning this page to the correct schedule now. Executing PD manual reassign.

pagerduty-bot: Manual reassign initiated by Tariq - SRE. API call: ```curl -X POST "https://api.pagerduty.example/incidents/INC123456/reassign" -H "Authorization: Token token=***" -d '{"service": "infra-night"}'```

pagerduty-bot: Page reassigned to service `infra-night`. Escalation policy `infra-night` now receiving notifications. :white_check_mark:

Morgan (on-call): got it, ACK on infra-night. I'm triaging the high p95. Initial observation: KV cache fill rate spiked -> longer token generation times.

Priya N: any customer-facing impact? should we open a banner?

Morgan (on-call): preliminary: 12 minutes of elevated latency for a subset of hosted API tenants in us-west2 (not all customers). No data loss. I'm switching traffic to the canary model variant and enabling prefix cache warmup to mitigate.

Alex W: Can you paste the mitigation commands?

Morgan (on-call): Doing canary redirect now: ```rctl route set --cluster us-west2 --from redwood-v2-8b --to redwood-v2-8b-canary --weight 100 --reason "latency mitigation"``` Then warming cache with: ```python scripts/warm_kv.py --model redwood-v2-8b-canary --region us-west2 --tokens 50000```

Tariq - SRE: Noted. I'm also patching the PD mapping: updating mapping file in infra-config repo and will create a small PR. Patch: `data-orchestration-night -> infra-night` and add test for schedule alias.

Alex W: creating tracking ticket INF-3729 to follow up on root cause, schedule fix, and postmortem. Link: https://jira.example/INF-3729

Priya N: For transparency, I'll send a short status note to #customer-impact with current scope (US-WEST latency, limited tenants, mitigation in place).

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC123456 acknowledged by Morgan (on-call).

Morgan (on-call): Latency normalized after canary switch + cache warmup. p95 down to ~280ms. Monitoring for 15m.

Tariq - SRE: I pushed PR #421 to infra-config to restore night alias and added an integration test to run schedule mapping sanity checks during deploys. PR: https://git.example/infra-config/pull/421

Alex W: Good. Next steps: 1) leave PD routing change in place; 2) follow-up in INF-3729 with timeline and RCA; 3) add runbook step to validate PD schedule mappings after config changes.

Priya N: Thanks everyone. I'll draft customer note and ping stakeholders if anything changes.

Morgan (on-call): Marking incident as resolved for now — will reopen if we see regression in the monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
